name: dsh-voice-assistant
description: 「小凤」always-on voice assistant for DeepSeek Harness: wake-word standby, speech transcription with LLM polish, voice-driven multi-turn session dialogue, spoken replies, and a 60s idle-sleep cycle that wakes on a chime or an incoming agent message.

scripts.test: node --test tests/host.test.mjs tests/experts.test.mjs tests/client-core.test.mjs tests/questions.test.mjs tests/visuals.test.mjs tests/expert-management.test.mjs tests/expert-sessions.test.mjs tests/expert-sync.test.mjs tests/asr-preference.test.mjs tests/local-asr.test.mjs tests/task-memory.test.mjs
scripts.verify: node build.mjs && node tools/smoke-bundle.mjs && node tools/check-session-integrity.mjs && node tools/smoke-host.mjs && node tools/smoke-agent-route.mjs
